title: Transition maps between finite perfect adic coordinates
statement: With the marked finite quotient coordinates of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-marked-origin], consecutive finite quotient coordinates admit coefficient-restricted maps dK_n. Every dK_n is universal after pullback to an etale source, in the structured-arrow sense used by [lem-weil-pbc-derived-scalar-extension-local-systems].

source.place: Tags 09AL and 09C6, with the balancing input of Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Conjugate each consecutive quotient map by the supplied coordinate isomorphisms and the coefficient-interchange maps. The bounded-below Hom bijection in [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-derived-hom-bijection] gives the unique etale preimage dK_n.

Use derived tensor balancing and the canonical tensor-pullback mate from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The normalized transpose is invertible, and exact faithful inverse image reflects this to the required structured-arrow universality, with coefficient functoriality supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-derived-scalar-extension-local-systems].
